Privacy policy

How calculators, analytics and advertising work on Measured Home.

Data kalkulator / Calculator data

Dimensions, openings, coats, paint coverage, surface area, allowance and box coverage are processed in your browser. This site does not send or store your inputs on a Vijeron server.

Analitik / Analytics

Google Analytics 4 measures visits and tool-use events. Events contain only the tool name and page language, not inputs or results. Availability depends on consent choices.

Iklan dan persetujuan / Advertising and consent

AdSense and Google Funding Choices code may load on content pages. Ad storage, personalization and analytics storage start denied until applicable consent is obtained. Google may process data under its service policies.

Kontak / Contact

Use the Vijeron contact page for privacy questions or corrections. Do not send unnecessary home plans or private addresses.

Measured Home

A home-measurement planning guide. Tool results are estimates, not a building survey or supplier quotation.
